comment:
Show an alternate solution too in addition to the one you have... Two squares with a shared vertex, with 2 internal matches, forming 3 pens each! 
Let's also make sure the captions are understandable. They are too short. I edited the claude.md to say "Captions should be the appropriate length, balancing ease of understanding with conciseness". We don't need super short captions in the hook. "Can you make 6 equally sized pens with 12 matches?" etc.
What does "Big triangle, side three" even mean for example? Viewers need some information to even answer.

Don't think the sheep are necessary. We dont introduce them in the short, so they kinda stick out.

We can also make the matches at the beginning a little bit less overlapping so that it is clear that there are 12. Maybe lay them out 2 tall by 6 wide (pointing upwards) with some level of random angle (not too much).
When "pause and try it" is on the screen, put the first caption back up with it so people know what to be doing when they pause.
